risks.risk: Whether it powers on and prints/copies correctly (toner/DR/transfer issues, fuser faults, jam sensors). Photos cannot confirm functionality.
risks.proof: A short video clip of power-on to ready state plus a printed test page (or copy) showing output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service/parts) until a test print/copy is shown.

risks.risk: Toner and consumables condition (low/empty toner, drum/transfer belt wear) affecting print quality and cost to restore.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s toner/consumables status screen (or a screenshot) showing remaining levels and any warnings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming consumables may be low/near end-of-life (worst case: replacement needed).

risks.risk: Paper path and finishing options availability (duplex, bypass, drawers, any finisher) and whether they work.
risks.proof: A test print using duplex and at least one tray (showing paper handling) and a photo/video of any finisher/stacker operation if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming basic functions only (worst case: duplex/extra trays/finishing may not work).

risks.risk: Maintenance history / total usage (meter count) which strongly affects value and expected remaining life.
risks.proof: Photo of the meter/usage counter page (total prints/copies) from the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as higher-usage/unknown life (worst case) until meter is provided.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not obvious in one angle (hidden dents, misalignment, leaks, broken covers/rollers).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of paper feed rollers, inside paper path access panels, and any error-prone areas (plus a shake/inspection for loose parts).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically worn with potential internal wear (worst case) until inspected.

proof_requests: Video: power on → ready state → print/copy a test page (showing output).
Photo/screenshot of toner/consumables status and any active error messages.
Photo of meter/usage counter page (total prints/copies).
Photos of inside paper path/rollers and any access panels (to confirm no damage/leaks).
If duplex/any finishing is claimed: show duplex test and tray selection working.
response.reason: The photos confirm the exact model (bizhub PRO C754e), but they cannot verify working condition, toner/consumables status, meter count, or paper handling—these determine the real Lagos resale price. Request proof via a test print/copy and meter/toner screenshots.
